body: Edge-native MoE serving engine designed for running 290B+ frontier models locally on consumer GPUs and CPUs
plain_description: FreeToken lets you run massive 290B+ frontier MoE models locally on consumer PCs and gaming hardware. It pools your GPU, CPU, and host RAM into an elastic inference platform with bandwidth-adaptive execution and smart KV caching — cutting the hardware barrier for frontier-scale open AI.
technical_description: FreeToken is an edge-native Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) serving engine that coordinates heterogeneous edge resources (GPUs, CPUs, system RAM, PCIe interconnects). It features bandwidth-adaptive CPU-GPU co-execution (q* policy), full-layer double-buffered prefill streaming, global LRU expert caching, semantic anchor checkpoints for KV state, and the FTW fast weight format with runtime VRAM reallocation.
title: FreeToken
